### Planner Response

Implemented and validated. Root cause was a mix of **render fallback** and **state sync gaps**.

### ✅ What I changed

1. **Preset card preview now renders saved rotation per section**
   - [AppLayoutPreview](file:///c:/Users/javie/AndroidStudioProjects/TeXter2025/app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/ColorPickerDialog.kt:1055:0-2021:1) now accepts per-section rotation params and uses them when section is not actively being edited (e.g. `targetSection = "none"` in preset cards).
   - File: @app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/ColorPickerDialog.kt#1087-1112
   - Rotation application updates:
     - BG: @app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/ColorPickerDialog.kt#1180-1183
     - File list bg: @app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/ColorPickerDialog.kt#1389-1393
     - File list item: @app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/ColorPickerDialog.kt#1528-1532
     - Content: @app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/ColorPickerDialog.kt#1695-1699
     - Memo: @app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/ColorPickerDialog.kt#1918-1922

2. **Settings preset cards now load/pass live rotation state**
   - Added live rotation state vars for all 5 sections and read from SharedPreferences.
   - Threaded those values through `PresetCard -> AppLayoutPreview`.
   - State load: @app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/SettingsScreen.kt#3484-3541  
   - Pass-through to card: @app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/SettingsScreen.kt#3641-3661  
   - Card signature + forwarding: @app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/SettingsScreen.kt#3804-3824, @app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/SettingsScreen.kt#4011-4030

3. **Main app surfaces/state now stay in sync after edit + startup**
   - On startup active preset restore, now also restores per-section offset/scale/rotation and saves to prefs.
   - File: @app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/MainActivity.kt#1601-1668
   - In `onEdit...Color` handlers, section live state + prefs now updated immediately (including rotation), so app surfaces and cards use current values.
   - Content: @app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/MainActivity.kt#2185-2197  
   - Memo: @app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/MainActivity.kt#2247-2259  
   - BG: @app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/MainActivity.kt#2430-2442  
   - File item: @app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/MainActivity.kt#2617-2629  
   - File bg: @app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/MainActivity.kt#2800-2812  
   - Also fixed file-list-bg preset writeback to use incoming `offsetX/offsetY/scale` (not stale vars): @app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/MainActivity.kt#2819-2823

4. **Docs updated (per your project rules)**

### Planner Response

Fixed. The rotation gap was in the **opened note editor path** ([FileEditDialog](file:///c:/Users/javie/AndroidStudioProjects/TeXter2025/app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/FileEditDialog.kt:90:0-1036:1)), not the preview components.

### What I changed

1. **Added missing rotation prop to [FileEditDialog](file:///c:/Users/javie/AndroidStudioProjects/TeXter2025/app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/FileEditDialog.kt:90:0-1036:1)**
   - Added `customBgPhotoRotation: Float = 0f` to the composable signature.
   - File: @app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/FileEditDialog.kt#105-117

2. **Applied rotation in the opened-note background render layer**
   - Added `rotationZ = customBgPhotoRotation` inside the background image `graphicsLayer`.
   - File: @app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/FileEditDialog.kt#562-574

3. **Threaded real photo transform state from [MainActivity](file:///c:/Users/javie/AndroidStudioProjects/TeXter2025/app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/MainActivity.kt:52:0-4397:1) into [FileEditDialog](file:///c:/Users/javie/AndroidStudioProjects/TeXter2025/app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/FileEditDialog.kt:90:0-1036:1)**
   - Passed:
     - `customBgPhotoUri`
     - `customBgPhotoAlpha`
     - `customBgPhotoBlur`
     - `customBgPhotoOffsetX`
     - `customBgPhotoOffsetY`
     - `customBgPhotoScale`
     - `customBgPhotoRotation`
   - File: @app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/MainActivity.kt#4584-4597

### Why this fixes it

The opened text-file screen was using a separate rendering path that:
- didn’t receive the current transform state, and
- didn’t apply `rotationZ` even when transform data existed.

So preview/preset rotations looked correct, but the actual opened editor looked unrotated. This is now aligned.

### Validation

- `./gradlew.bat :app:compileDebugKotlin` ✅ passed.

- Added changelog entry: @CHANGELOG.md#13-40  
- Added session history entry: @CHAT_HISTORY.md#3-27

### Planner Response

Found another real gap and fixed it.

### Root cause from your latest logs/flow
The remaining issue was in the **Settings edit-existing photo-square path** (not the new/add path).  
[UnifiedBackgroundEditor](file:///c:/Users/javie/AndroidStudioProjects/TeXter2025/app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/UnifiedBackgroundEditor.kt:23:0-538:1) rotation changes were not being routed back in that edit branch, so offset/scale updated, but rotation could stay stale downstream.

### Fix applied
In [SettingsScreen](file:///c:/Users/javie/AndroidStudioProjects/TeXter2025/app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/SettingsScreen.kt:150:0-830:1) edit dialog wiring, I added the missing rotation callback path:

- Added `onPhotoRotationChange = { ... }` in the edit [UnifiedBackgroundEditor(...)](file:///c:/Users/javie/AndroidStudioProjects/TeXter2025/app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/UnifiedBackgroundEditor.kt:23:0-538:1) call
- Routed by section:
  - `content` -> `onContentAreaPhotoRotationChange`
  - `memo` -> `onMemoAreaPhotoRotationChange`
  - `fileListItem` -> `onFileListItemPhotoRotationChange`
  - `fileListBg` -> `onFileListBgPhotoRotationChange`
  - default/background -> `onBackgroundPhotoRotationChange`
- Synced `presetToEdit.photoRotation` and `onEditCustomColor(...)` payload to keep preset/live state aligned

Code refs:
- @app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/SettingsScreen.kt#3294-3314

### Validation
- `./gradlew.bat :app:compileDebugKotlin` ✅ passed.

### Docs updated
- @CHANGELOG.md#13-39
- @CHAT_HISTORY.md#3-25

Please retest this exact path:
1. Settings -> edit an existing photo square (not add new)
2. Twist/rotate
3. Save/select
4. Open text file editor

If it still reproduces, I’ll add one focused runtime log at the [FullScreenEditor](file:///c:/Users/javie/AndroidStudioProjects/TeXter2025/app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/FullScreenEditor.kt:58:0-966:1) entry to print received `contentAreaPhotoRotation/customBgPhotoRotation` values and close the loop in one more pass.

### Planner Response

Implemented a focused root-cause fix: **[SettingsScreen](file:///c:/Users/javie/AndroidStudioProjects/TeXter2025/app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/SettingsScreen.kt:150:0-847:1) was dropping transform state before it reached [ColorsSection](file:///c:/Users/javie/AndroidStudioProjects/TeXter2025/app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/SettingsScreen.kt:1338:0-2460:1)**, so downstream editors got default values (`0f/0f/1f/0f`) even when [MainActivity](file:///c:/Users/javie/AndroidStudioProjects/TeXter2025/app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/MainActivity.kt:52:0-4397:1) had real rotation/offset/scale.

### What I changed

- Updated `SettingsScreen -> ColorsSection(...)` call to pass **all missing transform args** for every section (custom bg, content, memo, file list item, file list background), including rotation.

### Planner Response

Fixed another root cause from your logs.

### What I changed
When you tap an **existing photo square** in Settings, the code restored URI + offset + scale, but **did not restore rotation**.  
So the app could look like “same issue” even though values were partly updating.

I added rotation restore in that selection path:

- `onBackgroundPhotoRotationChange?.invoke(preset.photoRotation)`  
  @app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/SettingsScreen.kt#2849-2853

Also made plain-color selection fully reset transform state (offset/scale/rotation), so there’s no stale carryover:

- reset to `offsetX=0f`, `offsetY=0f`, `scale=1f`, `rotation=0f`  
  @app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/SettingsScreen.kt#2854-2861

### Validation
- ✅ `./gradlew.bat :app:compileDebugKotlin` passed.

### Plain-language checkpoint
- **Problem:** choosing an existing photo preset was not reapplying its saved twist angle.
- **What was done:** I wired that missing twist restore on selection.
- **Current status:** build is successful; this should now make selected photo squares keep their rotation in the editor path too.

### Docs updated
- @CHANGELOG.md#13-35  
- @CHAT_HISTORY.md#3-23

I followed your saved preference memory to include this short normal-language checkpoint alongside technical details.

### Fix applied

I found the remaining root cause and patched it.

The rotation values were being saved correctly in [MainActivity](file:///c:/Users/javie/AndroidStudioProjects/TeXter2025/app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/MainActivity.kt:52:0-4400:1) callbacks, but they were **not forwarded** in one key path: `Settings -> FileManagementApp(...)`.  
Because [FileManagementApp](file:///c:/Users/javie/AndroidStudioProjects/TeXter2025/app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/MainActivity.kt:4402:0-4748:1) has default rotation params (`0f`), [FullScreenEditor](file:///c:/Users/javie/AndroidStudioProjects/TeXter2025/app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/FullScreenEditor.kt:58:0-966:1) ended up receiving default rotation in that flow.

I added the missing forwards in:

- `customBgPhotoRotation = customBgPhotoRotation`
- `contentAreaPhotoRotation = contentAreaPhotoRotation`
- `memoAreaPhotoRotation = memoAreaPhotoRotation`

at @app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/MainActivity.kt#3904-3924

---

### Why this fixes your issue

Previously, even after twist was detected/saved, the file-open path could still reset to default rotation due to missing arg forwarding.  
Now, the saved non-zero rotation actually reaches [FileManagementApp](file:///c:/Users/javie/AndroidStudioProjects/TeXter2025/app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/MainActivity.kt:4402:0-4748:1) and then [FullScreenEditor](file:///c:/Users/javie/AndroidStudioProjects/TeXter2025/app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/FullScreenEditor.kt:58:0-966:1).
